source_paths = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_87/training_0.csv"
]

for path in source_paths:

    dfs.append(df)

# Since there is only one source table, no union or join is needed.

target_df = dfs[0][['Name']].copy()
